Execute.SQL: UPDATE CRLTRANSACTION T SET T.PF_PROCESSING_KEY = ? WHERE (( T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE > T.CREATED_DATE AND T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND ( T.LAST_STATUS_DELIVERED_DATE IS NULL OR T.LAST_STATUS_DELIVERED_DATE < T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE ) ) OR ( T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND ( T.FINAL_RESULT_DELIVERED_DATE IS NULL OR T.FINAL_RESULT_DELIVERED_DATE < T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE ) )) AND ( T.FINAL_RESULT_STAGED_DATE IS NULL OR T.FINAL_RESULT_STAGED_DATE < T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE ) AND ( T.PF_PROCESSING_KEY IS NULL OR (sysdate - to_date(T.PF_PROCESSING_KEY, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24-MI_SS')) >= (4.0 / 24.0) ) AND T.AWAITING_ATTACHMENTS <> 'Y' AND T.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' AND T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT IN ('PACT','PRUX','GRBR','AIE','AIGP','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA','LINC','FGLI','EQUIT','AIL','NIL','GL','GLNY','LNL','FGLIRES','VALICP','VALICI','UFLA','UBOS','LADD') AND T.TRANSACTION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT P.TRANSACTION_ID FROM POLICY P, REQ_INFO R WHERE P.TRANSACTION_ID=T.TRANSACTION_ID AND P.POLICY_ID=R.POLICY_ID AND R.REQ_ACCT_NUM IN ('1021','1022') )

SELECT DISTINCT(T.TRANSACTION_ID), T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE, T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE, T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, B.PF_BATCH_ID FROM CRLTRANSACTION T LEFT JOIN BATCH B ON (T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT = B.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT) WHERE T.PF_PROCESSING_KEY = ? AND T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT IN ('PACT','PRUX','GRBR','AIE','AIGP','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA','LINC','FGLI','EQUIT','AIL','NIL','GL','GLNY','LNL','FGLIRES','VALICP','VALICI','UFLA','UBOS','LADD')
